PC: Initiate sequence of actions to rule out causes of total airway obstruction (increase fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) to $1 0 0 \%$ , verify peak inspiratory pressure (PIP), switch to manual ventilation using reservoir bag, disconnect Y piece from endotracheal tube (ETT) and squeeze bag, auscultate both sides of patient’s chest).
Flip patient to supine position to optimize airway management.
Suction ETT and consider replacing ETT.
Alternatively remove ETTand bag mask patient
MK: Recognize capnograph and high inspiratory pressure changes which signify complete airway obstruction.
Anticipate onset of hypoxia upon inability to ventilate and recognize subsequent hypoxemia.
SBP: Mobilize resources by calling for help early during medical emergency.
Discuss disposition of patient with surgical team
ICS: Communicate diagnosis to health care team promptly to initiate collaborative action (removal of C-arm, retrieval of gurney and securing of surgical site in preparation for flip to supine position).
Initiate a discussion with the surgeon regarding options for positioning and modification of procedure.
